sections.summary: The Member suggests allowing carry over of unused annual limits for up to three years to balance prudent drawdown with flexible usage for lumpy needs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: At the same time, I am keenly aware of what Minister mentioned about the inherent tension between current and future usage, and that is why my suggestion to allow a carry over of unused annual limits for just up to three years, may actually balance the prudent drawdown constraints, while also permitting a flexible usage to meet lumpy needs.

sections.label: Annual scheme review and flexibility
sections.summary: The scheme is reviewed every year, and the suggestion on creating more flexibility will be taken into account.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As I say, we review the scheme every year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I do want to see how we can create more flexibility and we will take your suggestion into account.

sections.label: Serving about 100,000 seniors
sections.summary: This has been done over the last two years, serving about 100,000 seniors now, with more wanted in a few aspects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We have done so over the last two years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We serve about 100,000 seniors now and we want to do more in a few aspects.

sections.label: Engaging seniors since 2022
sections.summary: Since 2022, they have engaged more than 600,000 seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As I mentioned, since 2022, they have engaged more than 600,000 seniors.

sections.label: Seniors discharged from hospitals
sections.summary: The referral process with the ICCP addresses making sure discharged seniors are not left alone or forgotten.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For seniors who are discharged from public health institutions, that is, hospitals, how can we make sure that those seniors are not left alone, are not forgotten?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That is where the referral process comes in with the ICCP.

sections.label: Rider covers deductibles and co-payment
sections.summary: The rider covers deductibles and the 5% co-payment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The rider covers deductibles and the 5% co-payment.

sections.label: New lower-cost riders suitability
sections.summary: A question asks whether new April riders covering less co-payment at lower cost are more suitable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If I need a rider, will the new riders that the insurance companies are introducing in April, where you cover less of co-payment but at a much lower cost, are they more suitable for me?

sections.label: Riders, co-payment and premiums
sections.summary: Without a rider you co-pay 10%; riders may suit those wanting protection against large private hospital co-payments, but premiums rise with age.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If you are talking about riders, if you do not have a rider at all, yes, you do co-pay the 10%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If you are considering, I go to a private hospital where my bill may run up to hundreds of thousands of dollars and I want to protect myself against that 10% co-payment, yes, a rider may be suitable for you.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But do remember, as you get older, in your 70s, in your 80s, premium runs up to $10,000 a year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Without that rider, you are saving that premium.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But if you are always seeking care in a subsidised public health setting, MediShield Life kicks in, plus subsidies, it is very unlikely you are exposed to tens, hundreds of thousands of dollars of exposure should you fall sick.

sections.label: Withdrawal of amendment
sections.summary: The speaker seeks to withdraw their amendment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: With that, I seek to withdraw my amendment.
